answer: Copying the same citations across 298 aliases as a result forfeits the authoring cost 298 times while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. Because the signal index resolves every citation against the whisper checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the beacon audit keeps the resolved set. A farm of 658 identities would post 3199 proofs and burn roughly 4 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
